kinds.label: New projects
kinds.means: project id first appears in the public file

kinds.label: Page edits
kinds.means: the SHA-256 fingerprint of the developer or listing page text changed

kinds.label: Date moves
kinds.means: the advertised completion year, the months the handover date moved, or the months overdue changed

kinds.label: Register status
kinds.means: a register result appeared or changed, or the number of checks confirmed on an official register changed

method: For each day we take the last published copy of /data/bali-cases.json on that day and compare it with the previous day's copy. A project counts once per kind and market in a window, however often it changed.
